summary: Completed the plan's second and third dependency waves (Phases 4-6) on top of the prior dispatch's wave 1 (Phases 1-3): dispatch-worktree.sh now implements the FULL per-dispatch git-worktree lifecycle -- provision (free-space + concurrent-worktree-cap preflight, git worktree add, hardlink-clone .claude//.lake, PROJECT_ROOT-resolves-inside-worktree assertion, registry record), path, release (strips untracked .claude//.lake scratch first so a plain release is never falsely refused as dirty), prune (age-based staleness, sparing the calling session unconditionally), and land (specs/** refusal, dirty-overlap refusal, git merge --no-ff, conflict abort-and-preserve, PROJECT_ROOT-inside-a-worktree refusal) -- with 38/38 tests passing. Dispatch-site wiring is now live: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh mechanically selects worktree isolation (phase == implement AND task_type in the lean4/cslib family), calls dispatch-worktree.sh provision (deferring, never falling through to a shared-tree dispatch, on any failure), and emits new isolation/worktree_path fields on every dispatch[] row in both --dry-run and live modes; orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh renders a new '## Isolated Working Tree' section gated on a --worktree flag. 312/312 and 122/122 tests pass across both extended suites, including every pre-existing case unchanged (proving byte-for-byte non-disruption for every dispatch that does not select isolation). Redeployed and confirmed live in this repo's own .claude/ tree; core extension's own doc-lint/manifest checks pass -- the sole remaining verify-deploy finding is a pre-existing, unrelated literature-extension issue out of this task's scope. Phases 7-11 (postflight land/release/prune wiring, the contended-path manifest producer, the git-commit-scoped.sh refusal, the acceptance fixture, and final gates/redeploy/consumer confirmation) remain for subsequent dispatches. IMPORTANT for Phase 7: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh should RE-DERIVE isolation status via `dispatch-worktree.sh path <task_number>` (exit 0+path = isolated, exit 3 = not) rather than threading new CLI flags through skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's Move 3 -- that file is deliberately NOT in Phase 7's declared file_scope, and Move 3 extracts every postflight argument individually from the dispatch row today.
